# The SNES project's laserdisc segment table

`segment_timing.json` cuts Dragon's Lair's laserdisc into the segments the SNES port plays,
each with its first laserdisc frame and its length. It is how the laserdisc frames DirkSimple's
sequences start at are found in the CD-ROM's clips (`tools/game/clipmap.py`).

- Source: https://github.com/astrobleem/SNES-SuperDragonsLairArcade, `data/segment_timing.json`
